ArtifactRef.description: Where one produced artifact lives and what it is.

reference.description: Reference the caller can cite: the path or id the sink returned.

bytes.description: Size of the artifact in bytes.

width.description: Pixel width when the artifact is an image; omitted otherwise.

height.description: Pixel height when the artifact is an image; omitted otherwise.

role.description: What the artifact is to the run, such as csv, plan or summary.

description: Result of a tool that produces a file rather than data to read.

artifacts.description: Further artifacts produced alongside the primary, if any.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems the caller should relay, one per entry.

sensitivity.description: Per-field extras cannot annotate a file, so the artifact is treated as containing every input column.
